Locked in — 90s cubicle, fresh damage.

Slice: one cubicle bay, fabric partitions in muted grey/blue, CRT + beige tower PC, desk phone, paper trays. Fresh = sharp glass, clean partition tears, papers still bright, dust still settling, no rust or moss. Contrast: one intact cubicle edge next to the blown one.

Damage beats: blown window, dropped ceiling tile + hanging fluorescent, one overturned desk, dented filing cabinet, scattered papers.

No modeling yet. Next: I will vet reference photos/models for CC0/public-domain only, with URL, author and licence, and bring that list for your OK — nothing downloaded or imported until you approve it.
